visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male makeup artist with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt stands behind a female model with long black hair and a black tube top. They both look directly at the camera in a brightly lit studio environment with white walls and a curtain in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the female model's face; she has a slight smile, and her hands are not visible. The lighting is bright and even, focusing on her clear complexion and neutral expression. (3) A product shot features a hand holding a square eyeshadow palette with nine shades titled 'ASSAM' against a neutral studio background. The hand has a visible tattoo, and the lighting highlights the earthy tones of the makeup. (4) The male artist's hand holds a tube of primer and applies a white cream to his own hand before transferring it to the female model's face using gentle circular motions. The model keeps her eyes closed during the application in the same studio setting. (5) A bottle of liquid foundation is shown close-up, followed by the artist using a pink beauty sponge to dab the product onto the model's cheeks and forehead. Her face is centered in the frame, and the lighting is consistently bright. (6) Two shades of concealer are mixed on the artist's hand with a brush, then applied carefully under the model's eyes and on her chin. The camera captures her looking upwards to facilitate the application of the corrective makeup. (7) A powder compact is opened to show a white pressed powder, which the artist then applies to the model's face using a large, fluffy brush in light pressing motions. The model maintains a calm expression. (8) Returning to the 'ASSAM' eyeshadow palette, the artist uses a small brush to apply a light oatmeal shade to the model's eyelids, followed by a deeper coffee-toned shade in the crease. (9) An eyeliner pen is swatched on the artist's hand to show a dark brown line, then used to draw a precise line along the model's upper lash line, extending slightly at the outer corner. (10) The artist uses an eyelash curler on the model's lashes, followed by the application of black mascara from a tube. He then uses tweezers to carefully place individual false lash segments on her outer corners. (11) Eyebrow powder and then a fine-tipped eyebrow pencil are used to define the model's brows with short, hair-like strokes. She looks directly at the camera with a neutral gaze. (12) A pinkish-peach blush is applied to the apples of the model's cheeks with a brush, followed by a nude-colored lipstick applied directly to her lips. (13) The final look is revealed with the male artist and female model both waving at the camera and smiling broadly. The background remains the same bright studio with professional lighting.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The male artist wears a clean white t-shirt and has styled dark hair. The female model has long, sleek black hair and wears a black strapless tube top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, professional makeup studio with white walls, soft grey curtains, and bright, diffused professional lighting equipment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins with a steady 4-on-the-floor beat. A male voice introduces the video with a bright, welcoming tone. A 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of on-screen titles. (2) The male narrator's speech rate is moderate as he describes the primer application. Low-frequency thuds and subtle brush-sweeping SFX are layered over the music. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to foundation application. The narrator maintains high vocal arousal, emphasizing the product number with clear articulation. (4) Rhythmic tapping SFX matches the visual of the sponge application. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (5) Mixing sounds, a faint liquid slosh, are heard as concealer is prepared. The narrator's pitch variability increases as he explains the color correction. (6) A sharp 'click' SFX occurs when the eyeshadow palette is handled. The narrator's tone becomes more instructional and focused. (7) High-frequency sparkle SFX plays during a visual highlight. The BGM beat stays prominent in the background mix. (8) Scratching and sliding sounds of an eyebrow pencil are clearly audible. The narrator's volume is slightly lower but very clear. (9) A final 'stinger' musical flourish accompanies the conclusion. The narrator waves goodbye, his voice full of positive valence, followed by a quick fade-out of the music and studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Step-by-step Application -> Final Reveal -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a full makeup look using KAIBEAUTY products, specifically the Assam eyeshadow palette, in a high-production-value tutorial format meant for social media marketing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and shows KAIBEAUTY products throughout every step of the tutorial with specific shade numbers and product names in titles.
